name: Internal Knowledge Base Assistant
businessPurpose: Answer employee questions from the internal IT and operations wiki.

logging.destination: Application logs, not yet forwarded to the SIEM

killSwitch.description: Manual: the on-call engineer disables the agent's service account. No tested runbook.

description: Single-tenant internal chatbot that answers employee questions from a curated, access-controlled internal wiki. It has no write access and makes no external tool calls, and the knowledge base holds no personal data. It retrieves only from vetted documents.
